product_overview: A high-frequency industrial telemetry cockpit for battery and hardware systems engineers. It provides live battery and ACPI status, vector-based historical telemetry visualization, and full telemetry archive export/import.
core_goals: Monitor live battery state of charge, power flow, health, and hardware status
Inspect historical telemetry trends across selected metrics and time ranges
Review multi-track telemetry visuals with interactive chart controls
Export and restore complete telemetry archives for offline analysis

features.name: Hardware Cockpit & Bento KPI Strip
features.description: Shows live battery and hardware telemetry in a dense cockpit layout, including state of charge, power dynamics, cycle counters, virtual health, and ACPI status.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View live State of Charge gauge and capacity metrics -> Inspect active wattage flow -> Read Coulomb accumulated cycle counters -> Verify offline charging audit ledger records

features.name: Monotonic SVG Vector Telemetry Chart
features.description: Displays historical telemetry as a pure SVG time-series chart with selectable metric series, smoothing controls, crosshair inspection, and zoom reset.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle metric series pills for Power, Voltage, SoC, Temp, and Health -> Toggle Bezier spline curve smoothing -> Scrub the crosshair across the chart to inspect instantaneous values -> Reset zoom to return to the full historical view

features.name: Channel and Date-Range Selection
features.description: Lets users switch the active telemetry channel and choose preset or custom time ranges for historical data exploration.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the channel dropdown -> Select an active telemetry metric -> Open the calendar popover -> Select a preset range such as 5m, 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, YTD, or Lifetime -> Select a custom calendar date range

features.name: Telemetry Archive Export and Import
features.description: Allows users to export the complete telemetry archive as JSON and import a saved archive to restore historical data.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click export JSON to download the complete lifetime telemetry archive -> Click import JSON to upload a telemetry archive file -> Observe the restored historical archive state

routes.description: BMS Telemetry & Hardware Cycle Engine Cockpit

features.name: Hardware Cockpit & Bento KPI Strip
features.description: High-density industrial cockpit showing real-time State of Charge (SoC), active power dynamics, 30-decimal Coulomb integration cycles, electrochemical virtual health, and ACPI hardware status.
user_interactions: View live State of Charge gauge and capacity metrics
Inspect active wattage flow (charge / standby / drain)
Read 30-decimal precision Coulomb accumulated cycle counters
Verify S5 offline charging audit ledger records

features.name: Monotonic SVG Vector Telemetry Chart
features.description: Pure SVG time-series vector engine featuring Fritsch-Carlson monotonic cubic Bezier paths (zero retrograde loops), pixel-density noise binning, dynamic non-overlapping Y-axis ticks, and interactive crosshair scrubbing.
user_interactions: Toggle metric series pills (Power, Voltage, SoC, Temp, Health)
Scrub crosshair to inspect exact instantaneous values with floating tooltip
Click Reset Zoom to return to full historical view

features.name: Channel and Date-Range Selection
features.description: Custom zero-native-control combobox and date popover for time range and metric channel switching.
user_interactions: Open channel dropdown to select active telemetry metric
Open calendar popover to select preset range (5m, 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, YTD, Lifetime)

features.name: Telemetry Archive Export and Import
features.description: Export untruncated lifetime telemetry archive JSON and import archives with zero-drift restoration.
user_interactions: Click EXPORT JSON to download complete lifetime telemetry archive
Click IMPORT JSON to upload and restore historical archive file
